$comment: Shared schema for every words/<lang>/*.json file (e.g. words/ja/, words/ko/). glossary_id links to https://kubernetes.io/{lang}/docs/reference/glossary/#term-{glossary_id} (matches the `id:` front matter in content/en/docs/reference/glossary/*.md, or the target-language glossary's own front matter). null when the term has no glossary page.

aliases.description: other surface forms to match in text (plurals, verb forms, casing variants)

translate.description: default behavior when no contextual_rules entry matches

translation.description: default rendering in the target language when translate=true; null when translate=false
dictionary meaning in the target language, keep it short

english.description: dictionary meaning in english, keep it short

glossary_id.description: id from content/en/docs/reference/glossary/*.md front matter, e.g. "cluster" or "kube-apiserver". Build the link as https://kubernetes.io/{lang}/docs/reference/glossary/#term-{glossary_id}. null if this term has no glossary page.

translation_sample.description: sample sentence using the word, keep it short, a full sentence is not needed.

contextual_rules.description: present only on terms whose translation depends on usage; checked in order, first match wins, else fall back to top-level translate/translation

when.description: human-readable condition, e.g. "refers to the kind: Deployment resource"
